d:
Welcome to another episode of my Oceania Series as I continue my journey to visit every country in the world.
In this episode, I leave Australia and travel to Papua New Guinea, one of the most fascinating and often misunderstood countries in the world.
I arrive in Port Moresby, the capital of Papua New Guinea, a city that is often described as one of the more dangerous capitals in the world because of its high levels of violent crime. Knowing this, I had no idea what I was going to experience once I stepped outside.
